verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits cleanly on white at the left with reasonable size and contrast, but most of the original's imagery is gone. The rows of coloured ART wordmarks and the left-side shapes are dropped, leaving one cropped magenta 'ART' fragment on the right, so fidelity suffers. B: it keeps more of the original's shape motifs, but they are clipped into meaningless slivers on both edges.
